verdicts.reason: The two candidates share the same defects. Each has a stray blue rectangle cut off at the top-left edge, a leftover divider fragment floating on the racket strings, and a second divider poking out of the panel into the photo. In both, the photo is blown up until it is pixelated and the racket handle is lost, the white frame is gone, and the headline breaks one word per line ('Win / a / study / grant'). In both, 'by submitting to' is ragged left and misaligned with the centred headline, with large dead gaps inside the blue column. B only moves the panel slightly left, so neither is better.
